description:
Teleport Connect provides easy and secure access to SSH servers, databases, applications, Windows desktops, and Kubernetes clusters.


Note: 18.11.11 was skipped due to an internal build issue.
- Fixed a Kubernetes deny rule with name: "*" scoped to a namespace blocking listing of cluster-wide resources such as nodes and CRDs.
- Fixed an issue where Windows Desktop Service aborts the connection during the RDP license exchange against Windows hosts with RDS CALs.
- Fixed an issue with MySQL database user provisioning that prevented concurrent MySQL sessions when using automatic database user provisioning.
- Improved teleport-update uninstall error messages.
- Linux desktop sessions can now be summarized.
- Improved the CPU usage of Auth Service instances in clusters with large amounts of web sessions and app sessions.
- Fixed a bug where clients using the Bound Keypair join method could become locked due to transient signing failures.
